brief: The type of processing represented by this span.
additional_context: Well-known values are request, parse, validate, variable_coercion, plan, execute, subscription_event, step_execute, resolve, dataloader_dispatch, dataloader_batch and _OTHER. Use one of these if it applies, otherwise a custom value.
Not to be confused with graphql.operation.type, which holds the GraphQL operation type (query, mutation, subscription) and only applies to spans that run an operation.
